ftbchunks.config.server.fire_spread_prot:
If true, fire is prevented from spreading across claims owned by different teams (unless the target claim has public 'edit block' permissions defined).
False by default; enabling this can potentially lead to server performance issues, especially when many blocks are on fire
If 'disable_protection' is set to true, this setting is ignored.
ftbchunks.config.server.flowing_fluid_pr:
If true, fluids are prevented from flowing horizontally across claims owned by different teams (unless the target claim has public 'edit block' permissions defined).
False by default; enabling this can potentially lead to server performance issues, since fluid flow ticks are checked very frequently, especially for large bodies of flowing fluids
If 'disable_protection' is set to true, this setting is ignored.
ftbchunks.config.server.nether_portal_cr:
How to act if vanilla attempts to create a nether portal for a player in a chunk that's claimed by another team
no_portal: allow the player to teleport but don't create a portal structure
failure: prevent teleportation completely
allow: just go ahead and create the portal as normal
